cover: UNICEF: five children killed in market strike
Drone strike on rail station kills 13
Six killed in 24 hours, ministry says

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Children among the dead
bullets: UNICEF says at least five children were killed in Monday's drone strike on a Nyala market.
A Yale lab reports a near-total absence of civilian life in El Fasher a year after the RSF took it.
No army comment was reported; the RSF says life in El Fasher is normal.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Drone hits a station platform
bullets: A jet-powered drone hit Dnipro's main railway station on Thursday as a train for Zaporizhzhia was boarding.
The UN says 10 people were injured, and condemned the attack.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Ministry staff among the dead
bullets: Gaza's Health Ministry says six people were killed in 24 hours.
A drone strike on a car near Maghazi camp killed two on Thursday; the toll from Wednesday's strike on an Economy Ministry post rose to four.
No Israeli military comment was reported.

stories.label: India · Assembly · Due process
stories.head: Dam opponents march again
bullets: Opponents of the Siang dam marched on Thursday, demanding its cancellation and the release of those in custody.
Police report 69 arrests in 53 cases, and notices to more than 200 people.
The state says current work is only feasibility surveys.
